spec: Hand-placed bezier paths (Catmull-Rom through hand-read points -> cubic C), stroke #1a1a1a round caps/joins; pumpkin & ghost_big stroke 9 (6-7 for small ghosts/faces/web); doodles ~250 units, stroke 7. Flat fills only. Scripts: tools/pumpkin2/.

pumpkin_hinge.description: Both hinges are horizontal. part-top ends at y=190; part-inside spans y 190..612; part-bottom starts at y=612. pumpkin_folded uses identical part-top/part-bottom geometry with part-bottom transform translate(0,-422) and no part-inside: the lower teeth tips then sit on the upper mouth line, side outlines continue straight through the hinge.
pumpkin_hinge.animate: Unfold by t in 0..1: translate part-bottom by (0,-422*(1-t)); reveal part-inside from y=190 down to 190+422*t (or scale (1,t) about y=190). Draw order: part-bottom, part-inside, part-top (ghosts in part-inside overlap the lower teeth slightly, as he drew them).

ghost_ids.ghost-2: top-left ghost hanging over the left wall
ghost_ids.ghost-3: peeking ghost under the teeth; its head (arc + two eyes) is drawn on the shell in part-top as group ghost-3-head, as he drew it, so it also shows when folded
